author: BourbonBonobo
body:
Hey it's AeroScape,


I'm in need of a strong, determined team, who wants to win, and wants to have fun at doing it as well. I'm a God at the bow. My name even mentions "aero" which shows my passion for the flying aspects of my snipes. I will seriously snipe the living hell out of anyone who crosses my boundaries. i'm not amazing at PvP, But I can do my best. I could seriously support any team who is willing to accept me. I'm a devout team player, I do all I can for the team, i'll make armor for everyone, make huge defenses to prevent incoming rushers, I'm an amazing architect, I can practically build anything you would want me to. I'm a great strategist, I'll do my best to help my team win, and become the best, And at the same time have a lot of fun in the process. My skype is: christian.hartley14. Contact me if you are willing to take me into consideration on being a part of your team! Thanks :D

<-----AERO------>
